decisions.reason: As the current analytics-standard plugin tightly complements the firm's core e-commerce support work, it likely continues to meet aspiration levels and there is little reason to reallocate its resources away from a proven offer.

The shop-relaunch SEO service is closely tied to the firm's established client problems and capabilities, so its performance is likely at or near aspiration levels and worth retaining despite normal service-line review.

The SEO workshops fit the firm's know-how and may support client acquisition, but as a newer and somewhat less central offer with more uncertain demand they face a higher risk of falling short of aspirations than A or D.
